title: 第13章 重点怀疑第14章 上门逼迫
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: 林文博看着那具盖着白布的尸体，脸色煞白，嘴唇哆嗦着，几乎站立不稳。
赵峰是玄云宗弟子，更是跟着徐长老和林慕清一起来到他林府的，如今惨死京都，他林家如何能脱得了干系？
玄云宗的怒火，他一个小小的礼部郎中如何承受得起？甚至有可能会影响到清儿、日后在宗门内的培养。
徐长老在看到赵峰尸体的那一刻，周身气息骤然变得狂暴无比，一股威压瞬间笼罩整个前厅。
厅内的桌椅杯盏嗡嗡作响，几个胆小的林家仆役更是双腿一软，瘫倒在地。
“谁？是谁干的？”
徐长老须发皆张，目眦欲裂。
赵峰虽性格跋扈，但天赋不错，是他这一脉颇为看重的弟子，如今竟不明不白地死在这里，让他如何不怒？
他猛地看向抬尸回来的城卫军小队副，声音冰寒刺骨：“在哪里发现的？可有发现凶手的什么线索？”
那小副队长被徐长老的气势所慑，战战兢兢地回应：“回……回长老，是在西城乌鸦巷……凶手……的实力很强，一击毙命，现场……现场没留下什么痕迹。”
“西城？乌鸦巷？”
徐长老眼中精光一闪，猛地想起昨日去过的方府就在西城。虽然距离乌鸦巷有一段距离，但这未免太过巧合！
“方家！”
徐长老几乎是咬着后槽牙吐出这两个字，“定是方家怀恨在心，暗中下手！”
林慕清此时也闻讯赶来，看到赵峰的惨状，俏脸也是一阵煞白，眼中闪过一抹惊惧。
她听到徐长老的猜测，柳眉微蹙，轻声开口。“徐长老，方家……如今只剩下老弱病残，方云逸更是手无缚鸡之力，他们如何能杀得了赵师兄？这……”
“哼！知人知面不知心！”
徐长老打断她，“方家虽败落，但难保没有几个隐藏的忠心旧部。昨日赵峰在方府如此折辱他们，那老太婆和那小病秧子岂能不含恨在心？”
“定然是他们买凶杀人，或者是动用了某些不为人知的手段！”
他越说越觉得可能，当即对着林文博开口喝道，“林家主，立刻派人，随我去方府！老夫倒要看看，方府装到几时！”
林文博此刻心乱如麻，只想尽快撇清关系，连忙应声：“是是是，一切听凭徐长老吩咐。”
林慕清却显得冷静一些，她示意父亲和周围惊慌的家人稍安勿躁。
“父亲，诸位不必过于担忧。赵师兄遇害的事情既然发生在京都，自有朝廷和京兆尹府追查。”
“我们林家与此事并无直接关联，只需配合调查即可。当务之急，是协助徐长老查明真相。”
她虽然不喜赵峰的为人，但同门之谊尚在，且此事关乎玄云宗颜面，她也不能置身事外。
只是，她内心深处，对于徐长老直接锁定方府，仍觉得是有些武断。
在前往方府之前，徐长老强行压下心中怒火，将林慕清叫到一旁僻静处。
content_en:
Lin Wenbo looked at the corpse covered with white cloth, his face was pale, his lips were trembling, and he could hardly stand still.
Zhao Feng is a disciple of the Xuanyun Sect, and he came to his Lin Mansion with Elder Xu and Lin Muqing. Now that he died tragically in Kyoto, how can the Lin family get away with it?
How could he, a small doctor of the Ministry of Etiquette, bear the anger of Xuanyun Sect? It may even affect Qing'er and her future training within the sect.
The moment Elder Xu saw Zhao Feng's body, his aura suddenly became extremely violent, and a pressure instantly enveloped the entire front hall.
The tables, chairs and cups in the hall were buzzing, and several timid servants of the Lin family felt their legs weaken and collapsed to the ground.
"Who? Who did it?"
Elder Xu's beard and hair were spread out, and his eyes were about to split.
Although Zhao Feng has a domineering personality, he has good talents and is a highly regarded disciple of his lineage. Now that he died here without any explanation, how can he not be angry?
He suddenly looked at the deputy of the city guard team who was carrying the body back, and his voice was cold and bone-chilling: "Where was it found? Are there any clues to the murderer?"
The young deputy captain was intimidated by Elder Xu's aura and responded tremblingly: "Hui... Hui Elder, it was in Crow Alley in the West City... The murderer... was very strong. He killed him with one blow. The scene... left no trace at the scene."
"West City? Crow Alley?"
Elder Xu's eyes flashed, and he suddenly remembered that the Fang Mansion he had visited yesterday was in Xicheng. Although it is some distance from Crow Lane, this is too much of a coincidence!
"Fang family!"
Elder Xu almost said these two words through gritted teeth, "The Fang family must have a grudge and did it secretly!"
Lin Muqing also came after hearing the news at this time. Seeing Zhao Feng's miserable condition, his pretty face turned pale, and a flash of fear flashed in his eyes.
When she heard Elder Xu's guess, she frowned slightly and spoke softly. "Elder Xu, the Fang family...now only the old, weak, sick and disabled are left, and Fang Yunyi is even more helpless. How can they kill Senior Brother Zhao? This..."
"Hmph! Know people, know faces, but don't know hearts!"
Elder Xu interrupted her, "Although the Fang family is in decline, there is no guarantee that there are not many hidden loyal members. Zhao Feng humiliated them in the Fang Mansion yesterday. How can the old woman and the sick young man not feel resentful?"
"They must have paid to kill someone, or they must have used some unknown method!"
The more he talked, the more likely it seemed, and he immediately shouted to Lin Wenbo, "Master Lin, send someone to follow me to Fang Mansion immediately! I want to see how long Fang Mansion can keep pretending!"
Lin Wenbo was in a state of confusion at the moment and just wanted to clear up the relationship as soon as possible. He quickly responded: "Yes, yes, everything is at the command of Elder Xu."
Lin Muqing, however, seemed calmer. She signaled to her father and the panicked family members around her to calm down.
"Father, you don't have to worry too much. Since the murder of Senior Brother Zhao happened in Kyoto, the imperial court and Jingzhao Yin Mansion will investigate it."
"Our Lin family has no direct connection with this matter. We only need to cooperate with the investigation. The top priority is to help Elder Xu find out the truth."
Although she didn't like Zhao Feng's behavior, the friendship between the same sect was still there, and the matter concerned the Xuanyun Sect's face, so she couldn't stay out of it.
However, deep down in her heart, she still felt that Elder Xu's direct targeting of Fang Mansion was a bit arbitrary.
Before heading to Fang Mansion, Elder Xu suppressed the anger in his heart and called Lin Muqing to a secluded area.
